notes.roads: Authoritative Maine E911 centerlines. Width remains a gameplay/visual heuristic derived from road class.
notes.roadNames: Street/road names come from Maine E911 fields and are retained for HUD, minimap and intersection signs.
notes.buildings: Maine ESCB footprint geometry. Residential location-detail attributes are not copied into game output.
notes.buildingHeights: Procedural heuristic with minimum-height/style overrides for named landmark buildings.
notes.landmarks: Named user-priority North Berwick anchors are geocoded at build time with OpenStreetMap Nominatim when available; known historic coordinates are fallbacks for Hurd Manor and the Woolen Mill.
notes.context: OpenStreetMap Overpass optionally supplies water, woods and farm/meadow context for scenery. Failure does not block the core Maine-GIS build.
notes.terrain: Maine GeoLibrary statewide elevation ImageServer, compiled to local float32 heightmap.
notes.orthophoto: Maine GeoLibrary regional orthoimagery exported once at build time; no runtime map service calls.
notes.streetImagery: KartaView street-level imagery is handled by the separate street-reference tool and is never fetched at player runtime.
